sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor's completed before registration; GPA3.0/4.0 from latest conferred
undergraduate/graduate/professional degree. UChicago BA/BS fits degree route in principle. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose West Lafayette Mathematics. Prepare SOP, personal-history statement, CV and all academic records.
Up to two program/campus choices per application share fee/materials. [s2] [s7]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior supervisor approval found;SOP names research-aligned faculty. Shortlist below partial; not evidence
of2027availability. [s2] [s8] [s9]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use central checklist; SendtoRecommender starts invitation; statusportal supports add/editreferees and receipt
checklist. [s2] [s4]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Deadline standingDecember1; new centralEnglish rules reflect2026scoring. Funding pages mix olddepartment
and current 2026-27awardvalues. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s6]

integrated subscores. Valid2years at recommendation; noMyBest/IELTSOneSkillRetake. TA language

recommendation; pending-degree applicants can be admitted under waiver but final degree transcript required
beforeI20/enrollment. NotifyMath and confirm department acceptance. [s3] [s4]

Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required upload CV/resume; noMath-specific length/format found. [s1] [s7]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required upload. Central encourages at most2pages. Prompt paraphrase: career plans, research topics,
preparation/skills/experiences (research mentor/role/outcomes), program/faculty fit. If two choices, cover both.
Formatting beyondpages unspecified. [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Required central Personal History Statement upload despite omission onMath checklist. About2pages
recommended byFAQ. Paraphrase: experiences demonstrating persistence/resourcefulness and readiness to
support a diverse academic community; optionally explain academic-record limitations. Complement SOP. [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Math undated overview: TA fromaboutUSD23,175/academic year, partial fees~USD300 and reduced insurance.
Old fellowship figuresUSD25,000-27,000+/12months. Current central Graduate Excellence
minimumUSD28,560/year(2026-27), tuition+medical supplement.2027Math offer not verified. [s5] [s6]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Math overview fellowship1-2years thenTA/RA up to7years total conditionalprogress. Current central
GraduateExcellence four-year award(1-2central+2-3programyears). Different award rules; obtain offer-specific
guarantee. [s5] [s6]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
Math recruits/supports international graduate students; award-specific citizenship restrictions not resolved. Do
not assume old external-fellowship list applies toF1. [s1] [s5] [s18]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress; half-timeTA about4classroomhours/week plus preparation/duties; central assistantship
norm20hours/week. [s5] [s4]

Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Fellowship candidates apply byDecember1; nominations throughprogram. Public extra essay/forms not
established. [s1] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Advanced research/summer fellowships,TA/RA and PresidentialExcellence supplementUSD10,000/year up
to4years. Externalawards require individual nationality checks. [s5] [s6]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD75international,USD60domestic, nonrefundable; card; covers up to2programchoices. [s1] [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Need-based central waiver UScitizens/PRonly. Approved recruitment/achievement program routes through
AdditionalInformation dropdown, verified aftersubmission; do notpayfirst. NewPurdue-student/alumni waiver
does not apply merely throughUChicago. [s2]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Complex geometry
Donu Arapura
Hodge theory, algebraic cycles, fundamental groups and perverse sheaves. [s8] [s10]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2025 · Perverse sheaves on varieties with large fundamental groups
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Takumi Murayama
Birational geometry, singularities, positive/mixed characteristic methods and vanishing theorems. [s8] [s12]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2026 · Pure subrings of Du Bois singularities are Du Bois singularities
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Shubhodip Mondal
Arithmetic geometry and homotopy theory; prismatic cohomology/F-gauges. [s11] [s17]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2026preprint · Height 1 group schemes and prismatic F-gauges
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.

Deepam Patel
Algebraic geometry, number theory, constructible sheaves and Euler characteristics; recent interests also
logic/AI. [s8] [s13]
AssociateProfessor andAssociateDean; current administrative role,2027supervision unknown.
Research evidence: 2026 · Nonnegativity of Signed Euler Characteristics of Moduli of Curves and Abelian Varieties
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Number theory
Tong Liu
Integralp-adic Hodge theory, Galois representations and prismaticF-crystals. [s9] [s14]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2024 · Completed prismatic F-crystals and crystalline Z_p-local systems
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Daniel Le
ModpGalois representations, Serreweights andlocal-global Langlands compatibility. [s9] [s15]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2024submitted onofficiallist · The weight part of Serre's conjecture over CM fields
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Representation theory
Baiying Liu
Automorphic forms, classical groups, Arthurpackets, nilpotentorbits andL-functions. [s9] [s16]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2025 · The closure ordering conjecture on local Arthur packets of classical groups
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Zhilin Luo
Representation theory and number theory; automorphic forms, L-functions, trace formulas, Hitchin fibrations
and related geometry, Fourier analysis on spherical varieties. [s9] [s17] [s19] [qbr9_q1] [qbr9_q2] [qbr9_q3] [qbr9_q4]
[qbr9_q5]
Assistant Professor, Purdue; joined 2025-26.
Research evidence: 2026 · Fourier transform and endoscopic transfer on real Lie algebras
With Cheng Chen; submitted 2025, revised 1 July 2026; to appear in Israel Journal of Mathematics. Local existence and Fourier
compatibility of endoscopic transfer.
Research evidence: 2024 · Nonabelian Fourier Kernels on SL2 and GL2
With Ngô Bảo Châu; revised 24 September 2024. Explicit nonabelian Fourier kernels, orbital Hankel transforms and stable orbital
integrals.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier interests: Spherical-variety Fourieranalysis, traceformulas, automorphicL-functions; recentpaperverification
incomplete.
